population: CHNS 2009 released-data analytical population: adults aged 35-74 years inclusive, linked person/wave records with documented male/female category and available age, BMI from released height/weight, central-serum glucose and whole-blood HbA1c under the frozen common-complete-case release policy. No diabetes, treatment or pregnancy exclusion is claimed. Age/sex composition is not supplied. This is a selected analytical sample, not a nationally representative population; no participant input.

measurement.description: Target columns retain task units. No source-population or specimen transformation is implemented by this feedback recipe.
